subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for `requireMention` channels, and what consent, retention, cost, inheritance, visibility, and failure semantics should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the feature intentionally processes and retains speech from messages that did not invoke OpenClaw, which changes a security and product boundary rather than only fixing broken existing behavior.

options.title: Define scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema, docs, provenance, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Wait for shared media-history policy
options.body: Keep this issue open as product input until maintainers define cross-channel semantics for retained unmentioned media and transcripts.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Keep current mention-gated behavior if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should not be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema, docs, provenance, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest combination of Discord preflight/config history and related issue-review context for the policy boundary.
